notes.title: Publisher & Nex Fest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150271/8475c5e02ed726f415681a892b028cad757cea83.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone, I'm Sunny. It's been a while since we last chatted. Today, I have two important announcements to make!

First and foremost, I am thrilled to announce that our game studio, Sunny Games, has signed a publishing deal for our Chinese-style pigeon-themed card game, "Fantasy Cao Cao Chronicles 2"! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150271/e421d22910b55297b0d6aeea2fbde12375d75c1b.jpg[/img]

Not only have we received an advance payment, but we have also recovered a small portion of the production costs. Additionally, we have gained a partner for game promotion.

The publishing brand we have signed with is Love Story Project, a subsidiary of Yamayuri. It is commonly referred to as LSP for short. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150271/6e9633df4dc6d7b3066e3af484737937acb4e818.jpg[/img]

Yamayuri, the creator of the million-selling heartwarming youth romance game "Tricolor Love," established LSP with a passion for and dedication to visual novel games. Last year, LSP published the popular yuri game "Wandering Streets."

True to LSP's reputation, the first thing they did after signing with us was to collaborate with other game development teams and create crossover skins. As you can see in the video's cover, on the right side, we have the original skin of Hattori Hanzo, lively and playful. On the left side, we have the alluring demon Hattori Hanzo skin after the crossover, equally adorable. And this pose reminds me of Jolin Tsai...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41150271/09eede29c7b7e1e534118d64febfa004e0323ed1.jpg[/img]

According to reliable information from LSP, there will be approximately 5 to 7 crossover skins like this...

Therefore, I believe the combination of "Fantasy Cao Cao Chronicles 2" and LSP will create a wonderful chemical reaction.

And now, it's time for the Steam Next Fest!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1913420/]Fantasy Cao Cao Chronicles 2[/url] 

will have its first public gameplay demo on the Steam platform on June 19th. It's worth mentioning that during the recently concluded WEGAME Playtesting Festival, over 2000 players participated and showed their support. We received an anticipation score of 8.7, which briefly placed us on the reputation charts.

Admittedly, the game still has room for improvement, and we need the continuous support and feedback from players. After a year and a half, we are meeting again on the Steam platform, filled with anticipation and a mix of excitement and anxiety. We welcome everyone to leave their opinions and suggestions in the community or groups. After the Next Fest, we will select strategy experts and outstanding feedback contributors and present them with a special "Fantasy Cao Cao Chronicles 2" custom-made Left Immortal mousepad. With eager eyes, we look forward to cultivating alongside you in the game. Its soft and dense texture will provide your wrists with intimate protection!
